hero.lede: Somebody wronged you in a small, unforgivable way. Put it on the record.
hero.counter: {filed} grievances filed · {lifted} lifted · office open since 2026

certificate.title: Certificate of Curse
certificate.subtitle: DULY FILED · SEALED · IRREVOCABLE
certificate.bodyGrievanceOf: a grievance of the {degree} degree, and it is decreed:

filing.heading: Your filing
filing.lede: The Registry does not investigate. It only records, seals, and delivers.
filing.priceNote: Delivered as a shareable link and a printable document.
filing.customTextHint: Kept to petty inconvenience only — nothing about harm, illness, appearance, or anyone's family.
filing.errorInvalid: Something in the form wasn't filled in correctly.
filing.errorEmpty: Write your decree before sealing it.
filing.errorBlocked: That wording isn't allowed here — keep it to petty inconvenience, nothing about harm, illness, appearance, or family.
filing.errorRateLimited: Too many filings from here recently. Try again in a bit.
filing.errorNameSentence: That name field looks like a sentence, not a name — please enter just a name.
filing.errorNamePublicFigure: Certificates can't be filed against that name.

preview.heading: Your certificate awaits its seal
preview.lede: Complete payment to unlock the certificate, get a shareable link, and download the PNG or PDF.
preview.paymentFailed: That payment didn't go through. Try again.

removed.heading: This certificate has been removed.
removed.body: It was taken down following a report from the Registry's moderation process.

footer.line1: thing.am · The Registry of Petty Grievances
footer.entertainmentLine: thing.am is entertainment. Certificates have no legal effect.

disclaimer.heading: This is just for fun.
disclaimer.body: Every decree is generated automatically from a fixed, pre-written template bank (drafted with AI assistance) — no one at the Registry writes new wording in response to your filing, and nothing here is meant to offend, threaten, or harm anyone named on a certificate. Certificates have no legal or supernatural effect.

ledger.heading: The public ledger
ledger.sub: Every filing is recorded. Names are withheld; the grievance is not.
ledger.empty: No certificates have been sealed yet.
